peers.name: prisma-upgrade-v7
peers.description: Complete migration guide from Prisma ORM v6 to v7 covering all breaking changes. Use when upgrading Prisma versions, encountering v7 errors, or migrating existing projects. Triggers on "upgrade to prisma 7", "prisma 7 migration", "prisma-client generator", "driver adapter required".

peers.name: prisma-compute
peers.description: Deploy and operate apps on Prisma Compute with the Prisma 8 CLI. Use whenever the user mentions Prisma Compute, deploying or hosting a Prisma app, `prisma deploy`, `prisma dev module.ts`, Prisma Composer apps (`module.ts`, `compute()`, the `composer` section of `prisma.config.ts`), preview stages, deploy on push (`prisma git connect`, `prisma/cloud-deploy-action`), `prisma service` logs, versions, rollback, or custom domains, `project env`, `PRISMA_SERVICE_TOKEN`, regions, 504s, sleeping instances, or `waitUntil`; also when a project still uses the removed `@prisma/cli app deploy`, `prisma.compute.ts`, `defineComputeConfig`, `compute:deploy`, or `build logs` surface.

peers.name: prisma-mongodb-upgrade
peers.description: Decision and migration guide for Prisma ORM MongoDB projects on v6, which have no upgrade path to v7. Use when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to prisma 7" comes up in a project with provider = "mongodb", or when evaluating a move to Prisma 8. Triggers on "upgrade prisma mongodb", "prisma 7 mongodb", "mongodb prisma migration", "prisma 8 mongodb".

peers.name: prisma-orm-setup
peers.description: Set up Prisma ORM in an application, connect its database, or troubleshoot the connection of an existing Prisma 6, 7, or 8 app. Defaults new applications to Prisma ORM 8 and loads the package-owned prisma-8 skill; keeps existing Prisma 6/7 apps on their version with provider references for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, CockroachDB, MongoDB, and Prisma Postgres.

en.tagline: Move a PostgreSQL app from Prisma ORM 6 or 7 to Prisma 8
en.summary: This skill upgrades a Node.js server that uses PostgreSQL and Prisma ORM 6 or 7 to Prisma 8 in one pass. The schema.prisma file, the database and its data stay as they are. It also prepares an app for deployment on Prisma Compute, which runs only Prisma 8.
problem: A PostgreSQL project on Prisma ORM 6 or 7 needs to move to Prisma 8. The change affects the Prisma packages, the config file, the migration setup and every query. The Prisma 8 upgrade guide is the source of truth for the steps.

With this skill, the app ends up on Prisma 8 with the same schema.prisma, database and data. The repo's own checks run before and after the change. Prisma 8 specific questions are handled by the prisma-8 skill that the upgrade installs.
fit: A PostgreSQL app on Prisma ORM 6 that needs Prisma 8 in one pass
A PostgreSQL app on Prisma ORM 7 that will skip straight to Prisma 8
An app that must run on Prisma 8 before it deploys to Prisma Compute
unfit: New projects, or apps already on Prisma 8 (use prisma-orm-setup or prisma-8)
steps: Run the repo's own checks first and record the results.
Remove the prisma package, install the exact Prisma 8 versions, and remove prisma generate from all scripts.
Write the Prisma 8 prisma.config.ts and sync the prisma-8 agent skills.
Emit the contract, sign the database, and create a baseline migration, then retire the old prisma/migrations folder.
Create the Prisma 8 client and rewrite every query, then remove @prisma/client and the generated client.
Run the same checks again and start the app.

zh.tagline: 将 PostgreSQL 应用从 Prisma ORM 6/7 升级到 Prisma 8
zh.summary: 这个技能可以一次性把使用 PostgreSQL 和 Prisma ORM 6 或 7 的 Node.js 服务升级到 Prisma 8。schema.prisma 文件、数据库和其中的数据都保持不变。它还能让应用做好部署准备，以便运行在只支持 Prisma 8 的 Prisma Compute 上。
problem: 使用 Prisma ORM 6 或 7 的 PostgreSQL 项目需要迁移到 Prisma 8。这次改动涉及 Prisma 相关包、配置文件、迁移方式以及每一处查询。升级步骤以 Prisma 8 官方升级指南为准。
使用这个技能后，应用会在 Prisma 8 上运行，schema.prisma、数据库和数据都不变。升级前后都会运行仓库自带的检查。涉及 Prisma 8 本身的问题，由升级过程中安装的 prisma-8 技能来处理。
fit: 需要一次性升级到 Prisma 8 的 Prisma ORM 6 PostgreSQL 应用
打算直接跳到 Prisma 8 的 Prisma ORM 7 PostgreSQL 应用
部署到 Prisma Compute 之前必须先运行在 Prisma 8 上的应用
unfit: 新项目，或已经在 Prisma 8 上的应用（请使用 prisma-orm-setup 或 prisma-8）
steps: 先运行仓库自带的检查，并记录结果。
卸载 prisma 包，安装指定版本的 Prisma 8，并从所有脚本中移除 prisma generate。
编写 Prisma 8 的 prisma.config.ts，并同步 prisma-8 的智能体技能。
生成契约、为数据库签名并创建基线迁移，然后停用旧的 prisma/migrations 目录。
创建 Prisma 8 客户端并改写每一处查询，然后移除 @prisma/client 和已生成的客户端。
再次运行同样的检查，并启动应用。
